summary: Iter24 ObjectId hardening verification — all 10 iter24 tests + 43 regression tests + 7 new positive-path tests PASS. Malformed ObjectId on user-supplied path/query params (account_id, trigger_id, signal_id, rid, cid) now consistently returns 404 instead of 500 across bot_routes, nl_routes, signal_routes and affiliate_routes. Happy paths (bot/config without account_id, bot/status auto-scope, valid-hex deletes, admin affiliate endpoints with valid hex) still work and do NOT crash. Backend logs clean — no 500s during the suite.
critical_code_review_comments: Affiliate admin endpoints (POST /api/admin/affiliate/payout-requests/{rid}/process, /commissions/{cid}/mark-paid) had a semantic change 400 → 404 for invalid ids. Verified by grepping frontend/src — NO frontend caller exists for these admin endpoints (only the user-facing /affiliate/* endpoints are wired up), so the change is safe.

Internal-data ObjectId wrapping in affiliate_routes.py (lines 198 and 300) now returns 200 with a 'warning' field on corrupt data. Behavior is sound for graceful degradation but worth noting as a new response shape — main agent should make sure any future admin UI consuming these endpoints expects the optional 'warning' key.

Static source-scan test (test_no_unwrapped_object_id_calls_in_user_input_paths) PASSES — confirms no remaining unwrapped `ObjectId(<user_input>)` calls in the 4 hardened files for the param names account_id/trigger_id/signal_id/trade_id/rid/cid.
bot/status endpoint correctly auto-selects scope when no account_id is supplied and does not crash even with stale per-account configs in admin data (verified end-to-end).
seed_data_creation: None — used existing admin account & syntactically valid non-existent hex ids (507f1f77bcf86cd799439011) for positive-no-crash checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter24 (ObjectId hardening carry-over from iter22) is fully verified. 60 tests total pass across iter22 security + iter22 live + safety_guardian + max_concurrent_race + iter26_max_concurrent_endpoints + iter24_objectid_hardening + iter24_positive_paths. The new positive-paths test file (/app/backend/tests/test_iter24_positive_paths.py) is reusable for future regression. Backend route_utils.parse_object_id is now consistently used across bot/nl/signal/affiliate routes for user-input ids. No frontend caller depends on the affiliate admin 400→404 change. Backend was hot-reloaded by supervisor; no restart needed.
